videos.desc: Mediterranean Style Chicken and Chips Salad. This is one of my favorite easy meals to make for lunch or dinner during the week!! It comes together in about 30 minutes and is packed with protein and fiber. Let me know if you try it out!  • • • • • How to:  + Season 2 large chicken breasts with olive oil, salt, pepper, garlic powder, and smoked paprika. Bake at 350 for 30 minutes or until cooked through.  + While chicken is baking, dice 1/4 c red onion, 1/3 c cucumber, 1/2 cup cherry tomatoes  + Prepare homemade tzatziki (store bought it also fine)- I do 3/4 c greek yogurt, 1 small cucumber (seeds removed and diced), 2 cloves garlic, squeeze of lemon juice, salt and pepper + Combine 1 cup pulled chicken with pre diced veggies, 1 cup chopped romaine, about 1/4 c tzatziki, lemon juice, salt, and pepper  + Dip with Pita chips  #healthysummersalad #easymealsathome #dietitiantips
videos.author: saltandsagenutrition

contents.desc: Mediterranean Style Chicken and Chips Salad. This is one of my favorite easy meals to make for lunch or dinner during the week!! It comes together in about 30 minutes and is packed with protein and fiber. Let me know if you try it out!
+ Season 2 large chicken breasts with olive oil, salt, pepper, garlic powder, and smoked paprika. Bake at 350 for 30 minutes or until cooked through.
+ While chicken is baking, dice 1/4 c red onion, 1/3 c cucumber, 1/2 cup cherry tomatoes
+ Prepare homemade tzatziki (store bought it also fine)- I do 3/4 c greek yogurt, 1 small cucumber (seeds removed and diced), 2 cloves garlic, squeeze of lemon juice, salt and pepper
+ Combine 1 cup pulled chicken with pre diced veggies, 1 cup chopped romaine, about 1/4 c tzatziki, lemon juice, salt, and pepper
